                    <div class="itemText">
                        <article>
                        <h3>TURKS AND CAICOS VACATION RENTALS</h3>
                        <p>Esencia is a 2.25 acre property of Provo native vegetation directly on the beach in Long Bay, Turks and Caicos Islands. The lush plants and trees are wild and natural, giving you the feeling of being in the midst of undisturbed jungle. We have built in a way that flows with the land and the nature. Our pathways wind through the bush and follow nature’s creation. Our buildings appear to have been dropped in. The smell of wild flowers tantalizes your senses and the beautiful wild orchids reveal their magic. With only 10 Turks and Caicos vacation suites in 4 elegant villas, it is designed for privacy and tranquillity.</p>
                        <a href="/photos/">browse our property</a>                        </article>
                    </div> 
                </div>
                            <div  class="info-section-box">
                    <div class="imgItem "  style="background-image: url('https://www.villaesencia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/732d7c_9f0a7d0cc0c0458da91e51436923ca51_mv2_d_4608_3072_s_4_2-scl.jpg');">
                                            </div>
                    <div class="itemText">
                        <article>
                        <h3>LONG BAY BEACH</h3>
                        <p>A 3 mile-long stretch of pure white sand a few steps away from your Long Bay Beach vacation villa. The rich and intense turquoise color of the sea will astound you. The warmth and gentleness of the water will appease you. You can spend hours in the shallow water very comfortably. You will often only see a handful of people on the entire beach and maybe a few occasional horseback riders.</p>
                        <a href="/long-bay-beach/">take a tour</a>                        </article>
